verdict.rationale: The evidence has no Render feature for issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent. MCP OAuth only says you 'authorize access to your account', with no scopes or permission limits documented. Managed OIDC issues short-lived tokens so Render services can call Anthropic/OpenAI, which is a different capability, and the environment-isolation control is an adjacent network feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
